I                                                                                                                                                                                    Page 1 of 1 
 
Assam Schedule VII, Form No. 143 
High Court Civil Form No. (J) 13 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (SR. DIV.), 
SEPPA, EAST KAMENG, ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Title Suit No. 03/2024 & civil mis. case No. 26/2025 
Shri Thomas Nabam -Vs- Shri Jacob Tana & 15 Others 
 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
16.10.2025 
 
 
Plaintiff is represented by his learned counsel Mr Taba 
Taison. 
         Defendant No. 1 to 18 are represented by Mr Takam 
Sunil who filed his vakalatnama for himself, Gongam Basar, 
Matim Yaram, Darmong Lamgu and Gyadam Cheda vide 
F/No. 44/2025 dated 16.10.2025.  
Today 
this 
case 
was 
fixed 
for 
issues 
and 
documentations in main case but both parties prayed for 
more time. Hence, the case is adjourned today.   
Heard Mr. Takam Sunil who acknowledge the receipt of 
service copy of misc. case No. 26/2025 and as such he seeks 
time to file reply. The prayer is allowed.  
List the case on 26.11.2025 for filing reply in misc case 
No. 26/2025 and  documentation and issues in main title suit 
as per order XIII of CPC, 1908. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
Civil Judge (Sr. 
Dvn), Seppa
